description: Calendrier du deploiement FTTH en zone RIP - Corse is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. Calendrier prévisionnel du déploiement FTTH (fibre jusqu'au domicile) Très Haut Débit en Corse pour le réseau construit par le délégataire Corsica Fibra. Cela concerne la zone d’initiative publique: toutes les communes de Corse sauf CAPA, CAB et Biguglia. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Digital and Telecommunications. Its keywords are FTTH, Tres haut debit, fibre, infrastructure, reseau, DTAN. The portal shows 416 records. The portal shows 2021-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
